title: California Public Contract Code section 5106 - Award to the next bidder and forfeiture of bidder's security
claims: Section 5106 provides that if the public entity deems it is for its best interest, it may, on refusal or failure of the successful bidder to execute the contract, award it to the second lowest bidder.
Section 5106 provides that if the second lowest bidder fails or refuses to execute the contract, the public entity may likewise award it to the third lowest bidder.
Section 5106 provides that on the failure or refusal of the second or third lowest bidder to whom a contract is so awarded to execute it, that bidder's security shall be likewise forfeited.
